current.text: He is a bench forward. He is not in the projected Houston starting five of VanVleet, Thompson, Durant, Jabari Smith Jr. and Sengun.
Durant and Jabari Smith Jr. block his minutes. He projects for about 25 minutes and has no realistic path to 30 minutes unless Durant or Smith gets hurt.
If Durant or Smith is out and he gets about 32 minutes, he would be about a top-70 player. Lloyd names him as his stash option in formats that allow stashing.
He is fine as a late pick. Josh is okay with him at pick 128, and Lloyd sees him as a last-round pick.
Josh worries that he will never get chances to handle the ball.
A poor 3-point month dragged his FG% down to 41.6 last season. His three-point shooting collapsed late in the season.
His FG% should improve this season.
Rockets reports say Kevin Durant will play fewer minutes. Fewer Durant minutes would open forward minutes for Eason.
Lloyd does not believe the Rockets will really cut Durant's minutes.
Coach Ime Udoka plays his starters very heavy minutes, which limits bench minutes for Eason.
More guard depth may push Durant and Eason into forward roles, which concentrates the frontcourt minutes.
With our March 28 end date, Houston has a weak 3-3-4 fantasy playoff schedule, 10 games over three weeks.
Houston has only 14 back-to-backs this season.
Houston is predicted to win 54 games and to play a conservative regular season without chasing seeding.

durable.text: He is a strong rebounder for a forward.
Assists are weak for his position. Steals and rebounds are his best categories.
One expert has always been lower on him than consensus. He never believed Eason would develop into a starter, and says that has been basically correct.
Udoka is a defense-first coach with a basic offense. He gives little room for error to players who struggle on defense.

note: Eason is a 1 to 2 USD end-of-draft flyer. Yahoo and ESPN both value him at 0 (ranks 153 and 178), and our league paid 2 USD last season. His appeal is steals, rebounds and the upside of a Durant or Jabari Smith injury, while his weak assists make him a punt AST fit. Early in the season, check whether his FG% recovers from 41.6 and whether the Rockets really cut Durant's minutes. If neither happens, he is easy to drop for a waiver pickup, and Houston's 10-game playoff schedule is one more reason not to hold him long.
